name: @projectd/ac-data-edge

scripts.test: bash -c 'export NODE_ENV=test SKIP_ASSETTO_ENV_LOAD=1; unset REDIS_HOST REDIS_URL REDIS_PASSWORD REDIS_PORT REDIS_USERNAME REDIS_DB BACKEND_WORKER_URL BACKEND_INGEST_URL FLEET_EDGE_SECRET CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT_URL CONVEX_URL CONVEX_SELF_HOSTED_URL CONVEX_WORKER_SECRET CONVEX_INGEST_SECRET; mapfile -t files < <(find src -name "*.test.ts" ! -name "*.integration.test.ts" | sort); exec tsx --test "${files[@]}"'
scripts.test:integration: bash -c 'mapfile -t files < <(find src -name "*.integration.test.ts" | sort); if [ ${#files[@]} -eq 0 ]; then echo "No integration tests"; exit 0; fi; exec tsx --test "${files[@]}"'

description: Assetto Corsa edge node: spawn AC, HUD, telemetry bridge
